label: Manga
blurb: Your reading list, read and browsed through Suwayomi, with a nudge when a chapter you are waiting for lands.
author: blue91321
notes: Chapters come through Suwayomi, a separate program you install that runs Tachiyomi extensions — this package ships no extensions and reads no site itself. MangaDex supplies each series' ids and cover, and MangaUpdates its release history; neither needs an account.
